description: The MBTA Blue Book Open Data Portal is the Massachusetts Bay Transportation Authority's hub for performance and ridership data. On 2026-09-29 its search API listed 72 datasets, including gated station entries, bus ridership by trip, season, route and stop, rapid transit travel times, headways and events by year (2020 to 2026), bus arrival and departure times, service alerts, commuter rail reliability and ridership, prediction accuracy, customer satisfaction and a comfort metric. The bus ridership file gives average boardings, alightings and loads for Fall seasons from 2016 to 2025 and is published under CC0 by the Office of Performance Management and Innovation. Coverage: MBTA bus, subway and commuter rail around Boston. Format and access: CSV, KML, GeoJSON and API downloads without registration. Licence and cost: free; CC0 for the dataset checked, others per item. Caveats: licences and dictionaries must be checked per dataset. It supports capacity planning, network flow and resilience studies using observed travel times and disruptions. It relates to the National Transit Database, the Bus Observatory and GTFS-ride in the catalogue.
